title: ABSOLUTE SCAM!!!
body: I would give this app zero stars if I could. I downloaded JoyShort and signed up for a subscription through the app. When I decided to cancel, I discovered there appears to be no way to actually cancel the subscription. The app tells you to cancel through your Apple subscriptions, but the JoyShort subscription does not appear there. I have searched everywhere in the app and on my phone trying to find another way to cancel and have found nothing. JoyShort says that if you cannot cancel through Apple, you should contact them by email. I have now emailed them multiple times requesting that my subscription be canceled and have received absolutely no response. I have not even received an automated email confirming that my messages were received. At this point, I am not willing to take the chance that they might eventually respond before I am charged for another subscription period. Since I have made multiple attempts to cancel and cannot get a response, I am going to contact my bank and report the issue to prevent another charge. It should not be this difficult to cancel a subscription. If you allow people to sign up and pay, there needs to be a clear and accessible way for them to cancel. Customers also should not have to repeatedly email a company with no acknowledgment or response just to stop being charged. I strongly recommend thinking twice before subscribing to JoyShort unless they fix their cancellation process and customer support.
